description: OpenAI-compatible speech translation to English (Whisper) — OpenAI /v1/audio/translations: speech in any language in, English text out (Whisper large-v3-turbo, task=translate). Send multipart/form-data with file= like the OpenAI SDK, or JSON {url} / {file: base64}. Max about 3 MB of audio. Optional prompt=, response_format json|text|verbose_json|srt|vtt. For same-language transcription use /v1/audio/transcriptions. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: audio_translations
